item.title: An Empty Nest, a Sudden Loss, and the Long Road Ahead
item.description: On an ordinary Monday evening this past June, after hanging my new bird feeder and chatting with me over dinner about nothing in particular, my husband died suddenly. We had been empty nesters for almost two years and grandparents for a year. Of course, I’m not the first person to grieve the loss of a husband relatively early in life.
